name: pi-embodied
description: Drive pi-embodied robots from Codex: the robot's primitive manifest as MCP tools, with an operator gate on high-risk motions. Tools mode only; units, code mode, VDM, memory and evaluation stay in pi.

interface.shortDescription: Robot tools from pi-embodied's primitive manifests
interface.longDescription: Observe and act on a pi-embodied robot (simulators and real arms) through the tools its primitive manifest declares, forwarded to the robot's env server. High-risk motions are gated for the operator. Units, code mode, VDM, memory and evaluation remain pi features.
defaultPrompt: Check the robot with robot_status and observe, then describe the scene.
Pick up the black bowl and place it on the plate, observing after every move.
